Name: Aristobulus
Role: Head of a household in Rome
Summary: Aristobulus is named only as the head of a household in Rome whose members Paul greets; the letter does not say whether Aristobulus himself was a believer.
KeyStory: Aristobulus is named only as the head of a household in Rome whose members Paul greets; the letter does not say whether Aristobulus himself was a believer.
LifeLesson: God's greeting reaches into whole households, and faith often takes root house by house.
